description:
One belief disputed by three others, so the conflicts share a party and acting on one changes the tension of the rest. Added after the mutant battery found that no fixture could catch `stale_view` — a loop deciding from the first reading it ever saw. On every previously frozen web the conflicts are disjoint, so tensions fall independently, the ranking never reorders, and a stale view is behaviourally identical to a live one.

The values are chosen so the ordering genuinely **flips** after the first action: initially `objector_b` outranks `objector_a`, and once the hub has been weakened the hub becomes the binding minimum for both, at which point only the valence gap separates them and `objector_a` outranks `objector_b`.

Also the realistic shape. Experiment 3 section 3.4 measured live webs as mostly one hop deep, but a single belief drawing several objections is exactly what an extractor produces from testimony about one disputed fact.

expect.note: The flip is a property of the fixture's arithmetic, checkable without the loop. What the loop does with it is the dependent variable.

beliefs.proposition: The incident was caused by the schema migration.
The incident predates the schema migration entirely.
The incident was caused by the connection pool, not the migration.
The incident was caused by the cache eviction policy.
